text: 8月11日，沪深两市全天成交额合计23209.86亿元。其中，沪市成交额为10667.37亿元；深市成交额为12542.49亿元；创业板成交额为6011.56亿元。
text_en: On August 11, the total turnover of the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets was RMB 2,320.986 billion. Among them, the Shanghai market's turnover was RMB 1,066.737 billion; the Shenzhen market's turnover was RMB 1,254.249 billion; and the ChiNext's turnover was RMB 601.156 billion.
